prompt.alinti: Everyone uploading PDFs to cloud is basically wasting all their tokens, and Microsoft has a free fix. So every time you upload a PDF, cloud has to process the entire thing, the formatting, the broken tables, the images, and all the extra junk inside the file. Each PDF page can consume between 1,500 to 3,000 tokens, so a 20-page document can burn up to 70,000 tokens in one shot. And that's before you even ask a single question. The fix is simple. It's called Markitdown, a free Microsoft tool with over 110,000 stars on GitHub. It takes almost any file, PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, PowerPoints, or even YouTube videos and converts them into clean Markdown text. So this can reduce your token usage by up to 70% and Cloud can give better answers because Markdown is a format AI models understand extremely well.

yontem.ne: PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/YouTube dosyalarını Markdown'a dönüştürerek token kullanımını azaltır.
yontem.alinti: It takes almost any file, PDFs, Word docs, Excel sheets, PowerPoints, or even YouTube videos and converts them into clean Markdown text.

yontem.ne: MarkItDown'u Claude Desktop'ta bir araç olarak entegre eder ve dosyaları otomatik Markdown'a dönüştürür.
yontem.alinti: Plus, MarkItDown comes with an MCP server. That means when you connect it to Cloud Desktop, it can automatically convert any file you upload to a .md file.
